subject: Request: admin activity export format and truncation policy
messages:
From: GreenClinic SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@greenclinic.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@greenclinic.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity export format and truncation questions

Hi Tessa,

We're working through the evidence list for our upcoming SIG/SOC 2 review and need a couple of clarifications on the admin activity export you offered:

1) Field truncation: when admin command outputs or long metadata fields are logged, do you truncate at export time? If so, what max length (characters) is applied and do you provide a hash/prefix of the truncated content so we can verify continuity?

2) Timestamp fidelity: are timestamps normalized to UTC in exports or provided in original event zone? We need monotonic ordering preserved for our ingestion.

3) Export formats: can you provide both a sample JSONL stream and a batched Parquet/CSV snapshot? We will run a timestamp fidelity test against a 1-hour window first.

Deliverables and timeline: can we receive a sample 24-hour extract and the export spec by Friday 2027-03-05? Also include transfer options (SFTP vs presigned S3) and manifest/checksum approach you intend to use.

Thanks,
Alex Monroe
GreenClinic SOC2 Audit Team

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: GreenClinic SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@greenclinic.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin activity export format and truncation questions

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide a sample and the spec. High-level proposal below; attaching a concise "admin_activity_export_spec.csv" that maps fields and example rows. (attachment: admin_activity_export_spec.csv)

Export options we can support immediately:
- JSONL streaming extract (line-delimited JSON): ideal for your ingestion pipeline; preserves per-event ordering.
- Daily Parquet snapshot: compressed, columnar for bulk analysis.

Timestamping and ordering:
- Events are recorded with an ISO8601 UTC timestamp at ingestion. We will include both the event_timestamp_utc and original_event_zone fields so you can validate timezone normalization. Exports will be sorted by event_timestamp_utc to preserve order.

Truncation policy (proposal):
- Default export truncation: 4096 characters per free-text field (e.g., command_output, comment).
- For any truncated field we include two sibling fields: <field>_truncated (true|false) and <field>_prefix_hash (SHA256 of the first 1024 chars) so you can validate prefix continuity.
- Option: for customers who require full fidelity we can deliver a redaction-enabled full-field extract under a strict transfer agreement; otherwise we offer a prefix-hash approach to keep exports compact.

Integrity and manifest:
- Every export bundle will contain an attested manifest (manifest.json) with per-file SHA256 and an HMAC-SHA256 over the manifest using a key we provide out-of-band (or via your KMS).

Retention windows / sampling:
- Standard retention: 365 days hot, 3 years cold (subject to plan). For SOC 2 evidence we typically deliver 90-day daily snapshots plus on-request rolling 1-year deltas.

Transfer methods:
- Presigned S3 (preferred) or SFTP (legacy). We can stage a small sample to a presigned S3 URL for your timestamp fidelity test.

Next steps: I'll loop in Kim (security) and Karthik (ops) for implementation details and ETA; we aim to deliver the sample extract and full spec by EOD Fri 2027-03-05.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
Tessa
Attachment: admin_activity_export_spec.csv (field mapping + examples)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, GreenClinic SOC2 Audit Team <soc2@greenclinic.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin activity export format and truncation questions

Alex / team —

Thanks, Tessa. A few operational clarifications from Security:

1) Truncation and verifiability: we agree to the 4096-char default. For any truncated field we will include: 
   - <field>_truncated: true
   - <field>_prefix_hash: sha256 of the first 1024 chars
   - <field>_hash_tail_hint: sha256 of the last 64 bytes when available (for parity checks)
This combination lets you detect mid-stream truncation without shipping full PII.

2) PII redaction policy: we will apply automated redaction for known PII (SSNs, full credit card numbers) in the export pipeline. When redaction occurs we set <field>_redacted: true and include a redaction_reason code. If GreenClinic needs raw data for legal reasons we can provision a scoped on-prem or dedicated transfer with an explicit data-handling agreement.

3) Manifest and attestation: manifest.json will include per-file SHA256, record_count, min_event_timestamp_utc, max_event_timestamp_utc, and manifest_hmac. We will provide either an HMAC key via your KMS OR a signed PEM using our signing key.

4) Transfer handshake checklist: please confirm preferred transfer method. Ive attached an "evidence_handshake_checklist.pdf" that lists required fields on your side (S3 bucket policy, accepted ciphers for SFTP, allowed IP ranges). (attachment: evidence_handshake_checklist.pdf)

5) Sampling and windowing: for the sample extract we will produce a streamed JSONL for a 1-hour window and a single-day Parquet snapshot. Please confirm the 1-hour window start time in UTC; once received we will push the sample to a presigned S3 location and share the manifest.

Let me know if you need a Docusign route for an extra transfer agreement.

Kimberly Park
Manager, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Kim, Tessa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround — looking forward to the sample.
